**About 1,290 hits across 94 files. Four zones must not be renamed.**

| Zone | Hits | Call |
|---|---|---|
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) | 5 | Frozen public contract |
| [vendor/reporting-sdk](vendor/reporting-sdk/src/client.js) | 20 | Generated, wiped on refresh |
| [migrations/*.sql](migrations/20250624_backfill_account_ids.sql) | 61 | Applied history, edits break down steps |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | 1 | Right side is the wire name |

Real scope is `services/**`, about 1,200 hits. SQL strings there name the live DB column. Those need a new migration first, not a find and replace. Ask whether they mean internal only.
